title: Terraria grid shop with buy-to-cursor, sell by click or drop, and buyback
player_outcome: 'Shop' opens your inventory with a 10×4 grid of the NPC's wares where the chest would be. Clicking puts an item on your cursor, and holding right-click buys one at a time, faster and faster. Shift-click or dropping an item on the grid sells it for coins. Recently sold items appear at the end of the grid so you can buy them back.
design:
Core, splitting TownCommerce into TownCommerce.cs and TownCommerce.Trade.cs:
- `Buy(npc, player, item, int count, BuyTarget target)`: Cursor merges into PlayerInventory.Cursor (same item with space) and otherwise refuses; Backpack is the existing behaviour and stays the default.
- `Sell(PlayerEntity p, Inventory inv, int slot)` generalised; the existing Sell(player, slot) delegates. Add `SellCursor(p)`. Both refuse favourites and coins.
- Buyback: per player, up to 40 stacks, newest first, not persisted. `Buyback(PlayerEntity)` and `BuyBack(player, index, BuyTarget)` at the stack's sale value.

New game/UI/Inventory/ShopPanel.cs in the panel host: a 10×4 grid of pooled read-only ItemSlotViews (SlotKind.Shop).
- Stock first, paged with arrow TextButtons past 40 items, then buyback slots, tinted, filling the remaining cells.
- Tooltips use TooltipContext.BuyPrice for the 'Buy price:' line in coin colours.
- Left-click buys 1 into the cursor (repeat clicks stack). Right-button hold buys 1 at HoldRepeat intervals.
- Dropping the cursor on the grid calls SellCursor.
- Coins sound on success; TooManyItems or TooPoor go to the StatusLine.
GameWorld.ClickSlot with SlotContext.Shop: Shift+click on a backpack slot sells (P2-07 hook).
`InventoryScreen.OpenShop(TownNpc)` opens the inventory with ShopPanel and closes when the NPC is out of TalkRange. The `ui shop` command routes here.
UiCommands gains `ui buy <item> [n]`, `ui sell <area> <slot>` and `ui buyback <i>`. UiProbes gains `ui.shop_slots` and `ui.buyback`.
files_modify: game/Debug/UiCommands.cs — ui shop, buy, sell, buyback
tests: TownTests: BuyIntoCursorMergesSameItem; CursorHoldingOtherItemRefuses; SoldStackCanBeBoughtBackAtSalePrice; SellingAFavoriteIsRefused; BuybackCappedAt40
town.cmds unchanged (`ui talk merchant`, `ui shop`, `town buy merchant torch`) passes

ui.cmds:
- `ui talk merchant` / `ui shop` / `assert ui.shop_slots > 0`.
- `give wood 10` / `ui sell backpack <slot>` / `assert ui.buyback == 1`.
- `ui buyback 0` / `assert ui.buyback == 0` / `assert inv.wood == 10` / `ui close`.
verification: Headless town.cmds and ui.cmds pass; lavapipe screenshot of the Merchant shop at 1280×720 (the grid is fully on-screen)
risks: The NPC phase expands shops (Dye Trader, Stylist, travelling stock). Paging handles more than 40 items.
